serviceName: Donation page on your own domain
description: Opens a creator's GoDonate.Me donation page on a subdomain of their own domain (for example donate.example.com). Adds a CNAME to domains.godonate.me (served through Cloudflare for SaaS) and an ownership-verification TXT record. Other records are not touched.
variableDescription: token: per-domain verification token issued by GoDonate.Me (40 hex characters).
